note: Effects for combat v1. PNG rows = directions (down, left, right, up) when `directions` is set, otherwise one row; frames left to right. Binary alpha. `anchor` = pixel in the frame to align with the reference point described in `use`. Swap/dodge afterimage: reuse the game's existing dash afterimage. Generated by characters/tools/generate_combat.py.

slash.use: player attack 1 palm-wind arc. Place `anchor[dir]` on the attacker's body centre (centre of its 32x32 frame); start on the attack's hit_frame.

slash2.use: player attack 2 double palm-wind arc (sweeps the other way, wider). Place `anchor[dir]` on the attacker's body centre (centre of its 32x32 frame); start on the attack's hit_frame.

slash_counter.use: attack 1 arc during a counter (gold). Place `anchor[dir]` on the attacker's body centre (centre of its 32x32 frame); start on the attack's hit_frame.

slash2_counter.use: attack 2 arc during a counter (gold). Place `anchor[dir]` on the attacker's body centre (centre of its 32x32 frame); start on the attack's hit_frame.

hit_spark.use: on every landed hit, centred on the contact point

alert.use: red '!' over an enemy's head once its windup locks direction (anchor = bottom centre, put ~2px above the head)

counter_text.use: gold '反击!' popup on a successful counter hit (float it upward ~0.6 s; frame 1 is a white flash for the first 0.1 s)
